methodology.signal: First observed close crossing above the threshold after a prior close below it
methodology.returns: Close-to-close forward returns at observed market snapshots; dividends, slippage, taxes and trading costs excluded
methodology.sectorRelative: Stock return minus the median same-sector return over the same event window
methodology.walkForward: First 70% of eligible entry dates is development history; final 30% is a chronological holdout. The score formula is fixed and not optimized on either split
leakageChecks: Forward price is read only from t+h
First saved snapshot is excluded as left-censored
Confidence and trap filters are applied before returns are read
methodology.caveat: The history begins when the repository started saving snapshots, so earlier signals are left-censored and excluded
